POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.

4. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

7. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.

8. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

9. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

10. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

11. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

12. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General workshop rules and regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Blending of lines and curves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
